The astronomical elements on which the Vedinga
rules are based, represent only the mean ( मध्यम )

the Moon’s actual (wpe) position in the celestial

advance or behind it. Besides this the Vedanga mean.
motions themselves are again not exact but only

exactly five revolutions ina Yuga of 1830 days; nor is
the number of lunar pakshas therein exactly equal to
124, as the Vedanga assumes it tobe. At the rate

3065-25636 .....(or roughly 365}) days. This yearly

position amongst the fixed stars by a month in advance.
